N = int(input())
prob = []
for _ in range(N):
    row = list(map(int, input().split()))
    prob.append([p / 100 for p in row])

from collections import defaultdict

count_masks = [[] for _ in range(N + 1)]
lookup = [-1] * (1 << N)
for m in range(1 << N):
    c = bin(m).count('1')
    lookup[m] = len(count_masks[c])
    count_masks[c].append(m)

current_masks = {1 << lookup[0]: 1}

for l in range(N):
    next_masks = defaultdict(lambda: 0)
    for mask in range(1 << N):
        prod = 1
        for r in range(N):
            bit_set = (mask >> r) & 1
            p = prob[l][r]
            if bit_set:
                prod *= p
            else:
                prod *= (1 - p)
        for msk, pval in current_masks.items():
            new_msk = 0
            for m in count_masks[l]:
                if (msk >> lookup[m]) & 1:
                    for i in range(N):
                        if ((mask >> i) & 1) and ((m >> i) & 1) == 0:
                            new_msk |= 1 << lookup[m | (1 << i)]
            next_masks[new_msk] += pval * prod
    current_masks = next_masks

total = 0
last_idx = lookup[(1 << N) - 1]
for msk, pval in current_masks.items():
    if (msk >> last_idx) & 1:
        total += pval

print(int(total))
